decision_cruda.rationale: LH-04 is down at TJ-C512-02. Radio and CMMS agree, and the likely repair is 11:30. LH-10 is idle in the workshop, so lending it has no home loss. Net is +3.8 oz, the best option. Every loan from a producing stope or heading has a lower net, and most are negative. Central's stockpile has little room (116 t), which limits the gain.
